newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's brewery H1 profits lower.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's brewery H1 profits lower.

text.p: Morocco's leading brewery Brasseries du Maroc said on Monday it registered 50.09 million dirhams ($5.7 million) net profits in the first half of the year, down 3.6 percent on the same period in 1995.
The brewery made a net profit of 52 million dirhams in the first half of 1995.
Its pre-tax turnover rose to 427.6 million dirhams in the first six months of the year, from 376.8 million dirhams in the first half of 1995.
Brasseries du Maroc controls 95 percent of Morocco's beer market. It also manufactures under licence Coca Cola, and Heinken brands. The German Heineken has a 2.0 percent stake in the brewery.
Morocco's giant holding company, Societe Nationale d'Investissement, and al-Amane insurance firm hold 51 percent of the company's stock.
One of the 46 listed companies on the bourse, Brasseries du Maroc was last traded at 1,380 dirhams.
